design: Gate two-step lookahead on normalized margin between best and second-best one-step proposal scores
interpretation: No tested local ambiguity threshold improves training edge recovery enough to justify additional lookahead compute. The median threshold is essentially identical to always-one on edge error while using over five times the compute; the high threshold collapses toward always-two. The next search direction should allocate compute to proposal breadth rather than lookahead depth.
